title: Security Governance
description: Declarative review criteria for AI-assisted coding security: dependency, secret, permission, insecure-code, repair-verification, and high-risk-action review.

categories.name: Dependency vulnerability review
categories.description: Review declared dependencies and runtime packages for known vulnerabilities.
categories.remediationExpectation: Update, patch, or replace vulnerable dependencies; record verification command.

categories.name: Secret exposure review
categories.description: Scan source code and generated artifacts for hardcoded credentials or secrets.
categories.remediationExpectation: Remove secrets from source, rotate exposed credentials, move to environment variables or a secrets manager.

categories.name: Permission surface review
categories.description: Review permission and capability declarations for least-privilege alignment.
categories.remediationExpectation: Tighten overly broad permissions, remove unused capabilities, document required permissions.

categories.name: Insecure code generation review
categories.description: Review AI-generated or modified code for injection, unsafe eval, missing validation, and other insecure patterns.
categories.remediationExpectation: Refactor unsafe patterns, add input validation, and re-review before acceptance.

categories.name: Vulnerability repair verification
categories.description: Verify that a reported vulnerability has been remediated without introducing regressions.
categories.remediationExpectation: Confirm the vulnerability no longer appears and related behavior is covered by tests or verification.

categories.name: High-risk agent action review
categories.description: Review agent actions that mutate state, execute commands, or touch sensitive surfaces.
categories.remediationExpectation: Require explicit human approval, use isolated workspaces, and preserve rollback evidence.
